_about: Wall-panel wall spec, AP Capital basement: Garage wall to the SAFE / AV rooms. mm, wall-local: x along the wall from its left end as seen from the GARAGE, z up from the floor of the model (survey zero), y = 0 at the wall face (Garage side), negative toward the Garage. Geometry: UCON survey = ~/Documents/AP_BF_Safe_AV.skp (probe 812c, 2026-10-17). From TM (rev3 DISEGNO PORTE, order 252260, DWG 2026-10-12) only the door profile (Andriy). Draft 2026-10-08: safeav_proposal.png. Built in the model by ARMED 813b. The ROOM file is AP_BF_SAV_Room.json (a room file named AP_BF_SAFE_AV.json would BE this file on the Mac disk - case-insensitive).

wall.name: SAFE-AV
wall._wf: model: Garage face on y = 0 along +x from x = 0, Garage toward -y (probe 812c)
wall._thickness: 362 for x 0..2900.5 (Safe room), 171.5 for x 2900.5..8026 (AV room); the step is on the room side (probe 812c)

levels._ffl: z from the model floor (survey); no stone plinth, no baseboard (as REC-LAU)

build_up._face: frame 3/4 in + Fastmount VL-03H recess gap 3.3 + panel MDF 22, as REC-LAU / Main Kitchen / ML Foyer

row_seam._: Andriy 2026-10-17 (rev of draft 2): 10 between the panels and the door leaf all round - the horizontal joint runs along the leaf top (2499), as the other AP doors (cladding top = the panel joint): lower 10..2499, upper 2509..2837

panels._explicit: Andriy 2026-10-17: TM leaves centred in OUR openings, joint 10 to the leaves and between panels, free spans split EQUALLY (968.5 / 2 x 1035.5 / 3 x 946.5) - = the draft of 2026-10-08. openings._h: UCON survey (AP_BF_Safe_AV.skp, probe 812c). Safe: the model opening runs to the ceiling; it will be lowered to the AV head (Andriy 2026-10-17) -> 2542.
openings.handing: opens into the Garage (pull side = Garage, TM 'DX A TIRARE'), hinges right seen from the Garage; integrated handle on the inside, push-to-open by TM (not guaranteed)
openings._profile: TM rev3 DISEGNO PORTE (DWG 2026-10-12, 'DISEGNI NOSTRI' ASSIEME / TELAIO / PORTA): frame 47 (lip 35), 5 from the wall jamb; veneered 50 leaf, no applied panel, leaf face = panel face. leaf._: leaf = opening - 2 x (5 + 47) + 2 x 9.5 overlap on the frame rebate (TM: 1222 -> 1137, 1000 -> 915) = 1138; h = frame top - 38 - 5 floor gap (TM 2535 -> 2492; ours 2537 -> 2494); top 2499, 3 under the head panel (TM 2497 / 2500)
leaf._t: TM rev3 PORTA plan (DWG): leaf 50 = face part 38 (full width, flush with the panel face, front on the frame lip line + 4) + back step 12 deep, 12 narrower each side (TM 915 -> 891), 2.5 clear of the frame body. Veneered, no applied panel ('PORTA IMPIALLACCIATA SENZA PANNELLO RIPORTATO'). Differs from D01 / DK1 / OB2 (leaf 43 + gap 3 + cladding 12 = 58) because this door opens TOWARD the cladding (Garage side) - Andriy 2026-10-17: as TM drew it
